definition_quote.value: "Registered interior design" means the design of interior spaces as a part of an interior alteration or construction project including the preparation of interior technical submissions relating to space planning, finish materials, furnishings, fixtures, and equipment, and the preparation of documents relating to interior construction that does not affect the engineered systems of a building.
definition_quote.quote: "Registered interior design" means the design of interior spaces as a part of an interior alteration or construction project including the preparation of interior technical submissions relating to space planning, finish materials, furnishings, fixtures, and equipment, and the preparation of documents relating to interior construction that does not affect the engineered systems of a building.

residential_practice_exempt.quote: A person engaged in an activity traditionally performed by an interior designer, including a professional service limited to the planning, design, and implementation of kitchen and bathroom spaces or the specification of products for kitchen and bathroom areas, in a noncommercial setting.

interior_decorator_exemption.quote: A person who performs the following services: selling, selecting, or assisting in selecting personal property used in connection with furnishings of interior spaces or fixtures such as, but not limited to, furnishings, decorative accessories, furniture, paint, wall coverings, window treatments, floor coverings, cabinets, countertops, surface-mounted lighting, or decorative materials for a retail sale

permit_submission_authority.quote: A registered interior designer may sign and seal an interior technical submission covering the scope of the registered interior design and shall have the authority to submit such interior technical submission to a state or local governmental entity for the purpose of obtaining any requisite permit for an interior alteration or construction project.

seal_required.quote: A registered interior designer shall have a seal with which to identify all interior technical submissions issued by the registered interior designer for use in this state.

responsible_control_defined.quote: "Direct supervision and responsible charge" means a registered interior designer's personal supervisory control of work of which the registered interior designer has detailed professional knowledge.

compensation_disclosure_required.quote: The rules shall include provisions addressing conflicts of interest and full disclosure, including sources of compensation.

conflict_of_interest_rules.quote: A registered interior designer shall avoid conflicts of interest.
